en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1357 - Sa'd al-Iskaf reported from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"Whoever recites these words, I guarantee that no scorpion or harmful creature will harm them until morning:

'I seek refuge with the complete words of Allah (swt), which neither the righteous nor the wicked can surpass, from the evil of what He created, from the evil of what He brought forth, and from the evil of every creature over which He holds control.
Truly, my Lord (azj) is on a straight path.'"
